title: hive-pool read: response body
description: A projection: the records read, whole, with the home, the time and the journal cursor they were read at. For items, the derived blocked, held and ready facts come beside each item and are never stored.

records.description: Each record whole, of the kind asked for. A request-outcome is the store's replay record of one earlier mutating request: the response it recorded with the digest of the request and the request that caused it.

derived.description: For items: the derived facts per item. For projections: the freshness per projection, computed at the read from the rules in force. In the order of records.

projection_header.description: What every projection the Pool returns identifies: its home, when it was read, the journal cursor at that moment, and whether the read was complete.

journal_cursor.description: The last home_sequence in the journal when the read began; 0 for an empty journal. A reader resumes the journal after it.

complete.description: False when a limit cut the list, or a record of the kind could not be read; then omitted names what is missing.

blocked.description: True when the item is not done and a blocked-by edge names an item of this Pool that is queued or in-flight.

held.description: True when an active hold is in force at the time of the read: a dated hold is inactive on and after its until time.

ready.description: Queued, not blocked, not held and not a decision item.

request_outcome.description: What the store recorded for one completed mutating request, so that a caller without a store of its own can verify a retry against the request it first made before it does anything that depends on the current state.

request_digest.description: The digest of the canonical form of the request the store completed.

causation.description: The request's own causation as the store recorded it: for a request word made, the hive-word request with the digest of its canonical form, the fingerprint a retry of that request is compared with.

derived_projection.description: A projection's freshness at the moment of the read, never stored: fresh when the rules in force for its scope resolve to the rendering's digest with no conflict.

stale_sources.description: Rules whose revision differs from the one rendered, rules now in force that the rendering did not read, and rules it read that are no longer in force.
